A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same ESC study with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G. Pages 2–22 have identical page content and rendering resources; differences are confined to first-page correspondence information and the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original segmentation experiments on four datasets, component ablations, spatial-occlusion tests, and appendix analyses of transferability, event sampling, and inference latency.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons in Table 1 and supplementary experiments in Appendices C and E–G.

M1.justification: The edge dictionary, Edge-awareness Latent Re-coding, Re-coded Consolidation, Uncertainty Optimization, and associated training and inference procedures in Section 3 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use DERS-XS, DERS-XR, DSEC-Semantic, and DSEC-Xtrm, with unchanged noise, spatial-occlusion, and domain-transfer scenarios in the main text and appendices.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SegFormer, SegFormer (E), EvSegFormer, TokenFusion, CMX, CMNeXt, and EISNet. Comparator membership also remains unchanged in the occlusion and efficiency comparisons.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, preprocessing, metrics, backbone configurations, training budgets, event sampling, and masking procedures are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices A–F.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendices C and E–G retain the same component, dictionary-size, noise, transferability, sampling, efficiency, and occlusion analyses, together with identical qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Appendix E.3 still specifies three latency measurements, each averaging 100 inferences, and Table 10 retains individual measurements and their average. No statistical or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results are identical. For example, Table 1 retains ESC mIoU values of 67.10, 65.22, 71.04, and 50.87 on DERS-XS, DERS-XR, DSEC-Semantic, and DSEC-Xtrm, respectively; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, losses, Equations (1)–(7), and appendix formulations are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same framework and dataset contributions, performance claims, and spatial-occlusion resilience claim, including the 2.55-point mIoU advantage on DERS-XS.

C2.justification: Explanations of edge-based fusion, pseudo-label limitations, transferability, robustness, and computational cost are identical. Section 5 retains the limitation that only event–RGB fusion is considered.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, dataset-construction instructions, and dictionary-training information remain unchanged. The stated code and dataset access information is also retained.

R1.justification: Section 2, the research-positioning passages, and all 61 references are identical; no cited work or novelty positioning changes.

P1.justification: v2 removes Yifan Zhao's correspondence asterisk and changes the footnote from correspondence to Yifan Zhao and Jia Li to Jia Li alone. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; the research prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All 17 figures and 11 tables retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement, including appendix visuals. The first-page text edits do not reorganize the page layout.

improvement.justification: The only revision beyond the arXiv stamp is the correspondence designation. Scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendix material are identical, so the PDFs establish no meaningful improvement or deterioration in overall paper quality.
